lines.text: Many learners say: I am interesting in music.
Better: I am interested in music.
Interested! She is interested in art.

native.tip: Ты увлечён — “I am interested in music”.

en.tip: When you feel it, say “I am interested in music”.
en.caption: Do you also say “I am interesting in music.”? 😅 You feel “interested”. A thing is “interesting”. Correct: “I am interested in music.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
